items.title: Interactive Brokers Group (IBKR) Adds Local Currency Funding For Latin American Clients
items.summary: Interactive Brokers Group (NasdaqGS:IBKR) announced a new funding solution for Latin American clients through a collaboration with Paysafe’s SafetyPay. The partnership allows clients in the region to fund IBKR accounts in local currencies via SafetyPay’s payment network. The new option is aimed at making IBKR’s platform more accessible and convenient for investors in key Latin American markets.
